requirement.acceptance: New UI records component/pattern alignment or explicitly documents an exception.

requirement.requirement: Use Noto Sans and Noto Sans Devanagari for Hindi support.
requirement.acceptance: Typography audit confirms family and fallback behavior.

requirement.requirement: Use semantic color and combine status icon, label, and color.
requirement.acceptance: Every non-neutral status remains understandable without color alone.

requirement.requirement: Provide visible focus and keyboard interaction.
requirement.acceptance: Keyboard audit reaches all interactive controls and focus is visible.

requirement.requirement: Preserve form state after errors and explain what happened, why, who owns it, what the member can do, what happens next, and when.
requirement.acceptance: Failure states expose diagnostic recovery content.

requirement.requirement: Use goal-based navigation rather than making Form 19/Form 13 the primary mental model.
requirement.acceptance: Routes and labels lead with member goals.

requirement.requirement: Clearly disclose demo status and never claim real EPFO backend access.
requirement.acceptance: Prototype shell and mock data state include synthetic/non-production disclosure.

requirement.requirement: Maintain mobile-first behavior and validate at 200% zoom.
requirement.acceptance: Responsive and zoom checks are recorded before release.

requirement.requirement: Test loading, error, success, blocked, and recovery states.
requirement.acceptance: Each priority journey has an explicit state matrix.

requirement.requirement: Do not silently redirect on session expiry.
requirement.acceptance: Expiry preserves task context and explains the next action.
